newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates fall, close back in normal range.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates fall, close back in normal range.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates ended at 23.50 percent on Monday, after soaring to 29 percent on Friday when banks expecting a repo rate cut were caught short at the end of a reserve period, dealers said.
"I think most of the deals were done at 23.50," said Brandt Friedrich at Commerzbank.
"It was just the first day of the period, and everything seemed to be normal. I think that for the whole week, this will be the level or a little bit lower," he added.
